certification.name: Cellebrite Certified Physical Analyst for Inseyets
certification.description: Analysis of iOS and Android extractions with Inseyets Physical Analyzer, including SQLite database review, deleted data recovery and reporting. Earned by passing a knowledge test and a practical skills assessment (80% minimum); renewed every two years through a recertification exam.
certification.currency_note: Price on request (no public price); exam included with the 3-day course, usually taken as a 5-day CCO + CCPA bundle
